# Geology Science

> A comprehensive educational resource dedicated to Earth science, covering rocks, minerals, plate tectonics, and the structure and processes that shape our planet.

Geology Science provides in-depth guides and references on major geology branches including petrology, structural geology, volcanology, and paleontology. The site serves as an educational hub for understanding Earth's composition, internal dynamics, and geological phenomena through accessible documentation and visual resources.

## Key Topics

- Plate Tectonics
- Rock Types (Igneous, Sedimentary, Metamorphic)
- Minerals & Gemstones
- Petrology
- Structural Geology
- Volcanology
- Paleontology
- Earth's Internal Structure
- Geologic Time Scale
- Physical Geology
- Mineral Properties
- Rock Formation
- Geology Branches
- Fossils & Evolution

## Foundational Geology

- [Geology Science: Study of Earth Science, Rocks and Minerals](https://geologyscience.com): Homepage introducing Geology Science site covering rocks, minerals, and Earth structure.
- [Branches of Geology – Major Fields of Earth Science](https://geologyscience.com/geology-branches): Overview of major geology branches including structural, mineralogy, and engineering geology.
- [Structure of the Earth: Layers, Composition, and Internal Dynamics](https://geologyscience.com/geology/structure-of-earth): Educational guide to Earth's crust, mantle, core, and internal dynamics.

## Rocks & Petrology

- [What Is Rock? Types of Rocks, Their Formation, and Complete Geological Classification](https://geologyscience.com/rocks-2-2): Overview of rock types, formation, and complete geological classification.
- [Petrology: The Science of Rocks, Their Origin and Transformation](https://geologyscience.com/petrology): Overview of petrology explaining igneous, sedimentary, and metamorphic rock formation.
- [Igneous Rocks | Types, Classification, Properties, Formation](https://geologyscience.com/rocks-2-2/igneous-rocks): Comprehensive guide to igneous rocks, types, classification, and formation.
- [Sedimentary Rocks | Types, Classification, Properties, Formation](https://geologyscience.com/rocks-2-2/sedimentary-rocks): Guide to sedimentary rocks, formation through accumulation and cementation.
- [Metamorphic Rocks | Formation, Types, Textures & Metamorphism](https://geologyscience.com/rocks-2-2/metamorphic-rock): Explanation of metamorphic rock formation through heat, pressure, and fluids.

## Minerals & Gemstones

- [Mineral Identification: Properties, Formation & Uses](https://geologyscience.com/minerals): Guide to mineral properties, formation, classification, and industrial uses.
- [Physical Properties of Minerals - Geology Science](https://geologyscience.com/geology-branches/mineralogy/physical-properties-of-minerals): Reference on mineral identification using physical properties like hardness.
- [Optical Properties of Minerals - Geology Science](https://geologyscience.com/geology-branches/mineralogy/optical-properties-of-minerals): Technical reference on mineral optical properties and microscopy techniques.
- [Gemstones: Properties, Types, Formation & Identification Guide](https://geologyscience.com/gemstones): Beginner-friendly guide to gemstone types, properties, and identification.

## Dynamic Earth Processes

- [Plate Tectonics – Definition, Theory, Plate Boundaries, and Hotspots](https://geologyscience.com/geology/plate-tectonics): Comprehensive guide to plate tectonics theory, boundaries, and geological impacts.
- [Physical Geology | Earth's Surface Processes & Formation](https://geologyscience.com/physical-geology): Guide to Earth's surface processes, plate tectonics, volcanoes, erosion, and landscapes.
- [Structural Geology Explained | Faults, Folds & Crustal Deformation](https://geologyscience.com/structural-geology): Explanation of faults, folds, stress, strain, and crustal deformation processes.
- [Volcanology: Volcano Types, Eruptions & Hazards](https://geologyscience.com/volcanology): Overview of volcano formation, eruption types, and volcanic hazards.

## Earth History & Paleontology

- [Paleontology | Fossils, Evolution, Ancient Life & Earth's Deep History](https://geologyscience.com/paleontology): Guide to fossils, evolution, mass extinctions, and Earth's ancient life.
- [Geologic Time Scale : Divisions, Periods and Eons - Geology Science](https://geologyscience.com/geology-branches/paleontology/geologic-time-scale): Reference on geologic time scale, eons, eras, epochs, and Earth's chronology.

## Optional

- [Gallery | Geological Wonders, List of Geological Phenomena](https://geologyscience.com/gallery): Visual gallery showcasing geological formations and phenomena images.
- [Videos | Geology, Wonders, Disasters &... - Geology Science](https://geologyscience.com/videos): Video library with educational geology and Earth science content.
